blocks.text: VoxelMaterialDef = { color?: Color texture?: string pbr?: boolean // true derives normal and roughness from its raster texture (png, jpg, webp, avif); omitted, false, a color with no texture or a .ktx2 texture derives nothing roughness?: number metalness?: number opacity?: number transparent?: boolean // See-through, as is an opacity below 1. A solid cube of it with no cutout (glass, ice) shows its picture's clear pixels as clear and draws no face between two cells of one such material. emissive?: Color emissiveIntensity?: number liquidKind?: string // Explicit liquid marker for onLiquidEnter/onLiquidExit; becomes other.liquidKind. surfaceInset?: number // Fraction of voxel height to lower the exposed top surface (0-0.99). Useful for liquids. solid?: boolean cutout?: boolean // Alpha-tested art (leaves, plants): the picture's clear pixels are cut away, and a cube of it keeps the faces between its cells. collision?: "solid" | "none" countsAsTerrainSurface?: boolean wind?: { force?: number } // Bends with the place's wind as a decoration item's `wind` does, the same word and meaning: the swaying cubes of one chunk move as one block (at the largest force among them), and a shaped cell of it (blockBehavior) moves whole, so a column of them moves as one stem, as far as a full-weight tip leans: about force × the wind's speed ÷ 2 metres downwind at a gust's heart, 0.32 of that between gusts, with a small cross-wind flutter, never more than 1 m (force 0.03–0.08 reads as a breeze). The picture alone: shadows, colliders and cells stay. Omitted or force 0: still. waveIntensity?: number // the waves of a liquid that wears `tones`, as the water material's: 0 to 1, default about 0.15; 0 is dead calm (with `metalness` 1 and `roughness` 0 it mirrors the sky, and the scene on high and ultra) tags?: string[] // Creator-defined tags for behavioral grouping (e.g. 'climbable', 'emits-light', 'bouncy'). Queried via ctx.place.voxels.query({ tag, radius }). blockBehavior?: VoxelMaterialBlockBehaviorDef tones?: string[] // The ramp of the cube's face: up to twelve colours, darkest first. A material with `tones` paints every face from the ramp in its `pattern` and ignores its `texture`; one without draws its flat `color`, or its `texture` tinted by it. pattern?: Record<string, unknown> // How the ramp lies on the face, in cells of 6.25 cm (`cell`: another size in metres, rounded to a power of two from 1/64 to 2). A tone is an index into the ramp, 0 the darkest. A unit: `blocks: { course, run, slide, joint: "both" }` (a brick, a plank, a stacked stone; `course` and `run` in cells; `slide` how far every other course shifts, in cells, or "own" for a shift of each course's own) or `cells: { size, radius, cracks: [width, share] }` (a fracture block, a clump; a crack is `width` 0 to 0.5 of a cell's reach on `share` 0 to 1 of the borders, drawn in the joint tone); `base` the tone a unit starts at (one, or `[lo, hi]`); the walks of one tone, each a share 0 to 0.5 of the cells: `speck: { up, down }`, `grain: { axis, length, up, down }`, `blobs: { size, up, down }`, `drift: { size, up, down }`; `joint` the mortar between units: one tone, or `[toneA, toneB, share]` (toneB on `share` 0 to 1 of its cells); `clamp: [lo, hi]`; `face: { top, side, bottom }` (tones up or down, -4 to 4, by the way a face looks); `accents: [{ tone, share }]` (share 0 to 1); `cap: { tones, pattern }` another look on the faces that look up; `edge: { strength, width }` (a line at the cube's borders: `strength` -1 to 1, 0 none; `width` a share of the cube's side, 0.005 to 0.4, default 0.06). A ramp with no pattern is grown matter: blobs a few cells wide. growth?: Array<Record<string, unknown>> // What grows out of a face that wears `tones`, as stacks of small cubes: up to six rules; the first rule that grows on a cell owns it: `on` ("top", "side", "under"), `clump` (the drifts' size in cells, a power of two 2 to 64, default 16), `cover` (the share of such faces inside a drift, 0 to 1), `density` (the share of a drift's cells that grow a stack, 0 to 1), `height` (`[least, most]` in cubes, 1 to 16), `width` (cubes across, 1 to 4), `step` (the share of stacks whose tip steps aside: a bent blade, 0 to 1), `head` (cubes of a head one cell wider than its stalk: a flower, 0 to 4), `shade` (-1 to 1, away from or toward deep corner shade), `ramp` (`[root, tip]`: two shares 0 to 1 of the face's ramp where the stack's root and tip sit, default 0.2 and 0.9), `tones` (up to four colours of the stack's own) and `headTones` (up to two of the head's; a colour past the count is dropped). A picture alone: no collider, no cell. material?: ScriptedMaterialSpec // An object's scripted material on this block's faces; uv() is metres across a face, normalWorld and positionWorld the face's, vertexColor() its color; plain while it is broken. }

VoxelMaterialDef = {
  color?: Color
  texture?: string
  pbr?: boolean   // true derives normal and roughness from its raster texture (png, jpg, webp, avif); omitted, false, a color with no texture or a .ktx2 texture derives nothing
  roughness?: number
  metalness?: number
  opacity?: number
  transparent?: boolean   // See-through, as is an opacity below 1. A solid cube of it with no cutout (glass, ice) shows its picture's clear pixels as clear and draws no face between two cells of one such material.
  emissive?: Color
  emissiveIntensity?: number
  liquidKind?: string   // Explicit liquid marker for onLiquidEnter/onLiquidExit; becomes other.liquidKind.
  surfaceInset?: number   // Fraction of voxel height to lower the exposed top surface (0-0.99). Useful for liquids.
  solid?: boolean
  cutout?: boolean   // Alpha-tested art (leaves, plants): the picture's clear pixels are cut away, and a cube of it keeps the faces between its cells.
  collision?: "solid" | "none"
  countsAsTerrainSurface?: boolean
  wind?: { force?: number }   // Bends with the place's wind as a decoration item's `wind` does, the same word and meaning: the swaying cubes of one chunk move as one block (at the largest force among them), and a shaped cell of it (blockBehavior) moves whole, so a column of them moves as one stem, as far as a full-weight tip leans: about force × the wind's speed ÷ 2 metres downwind at a gust's heart, 0.32 of that between gusts, with a small cross-wind flutter, never more than 1 m (force 0.03–0.08 reads as a breeze). The picture alone: shadows, colliders and cells stay. Omitted or force 0: still.
  waveIntensity?: number   // the waves of a liquid that wears `tones`, as the water material's: 0 to 1, default about 0.15; 0 is dead calm (with `metalness` 1 and `roughness` 0 it mirrors the sky, and the scene on high and ultra)
  tags?: string[]   // Creator-defined tags for behavioral grouping (e.g. 'climbable', 'emits-light', 'bouncy'). Queried via ctx.place.voxels.query({ tag, radius }).
  blockBehavior?: VoxelMaterialBlockBehaviorDef
  tones?: string[]   // The ramp of the cube's face: up to twelve colours, darkest first. A material with `tones` paints every face from the ramp in its `pattern` and ignores its `texture`; one without draws its flat `color`, or its `texture` tinted by it.
  pattern?: Record<string, unknown>   // How the ramp lies on the face, in cells of 6.25 cm (`cell`: another size in metres, rounded to a power of two from 1/64 to 2). A tone is an index into the ramp, 0 the darkest. A unit: `blocks: { course, run, slide, joint: "both" }` (a brick, a plank, a stacked stone; `course` and `run` in cells; `slide` how far every other course shifts, in cells, or "own" for a shift of each course's own) or `cells: { size, radius, cracks: [width, share] }` (a fracture block, a clump; a crack is `width` 0 to 0.5 of a cell's reach on `share` 0 to 1 of the borders, drawn in the joint tone); `base` the tone a unit starts at (one, or `[lo, hi]`); the walks of one tone, each a share 0 to 0.5 of the cells: `speck: { up, down }`, `grain: { axis, length, up, down }`, `blobs: { size, up, down }`, `drift: { size, up, down }`; `joint` the mortar between units: one tone, or `[toneA, toneB, share]` (toneB on `share` 0 to 1 of its cells); `clamp: [lo, hi]`; `face: { top, side, bottom }` (tones up or down, -4 to 4, by the way a face looks); `accents: [{ tone, share }]` (share 0 to 1); `cap: { tones, pattern }` another look on the faces that look up; `edge: { strength, width }` (a line at the cube's borders: `strength` -1 to 1, 0 none; `width` a share of the cube's side, 0.005 to 0.4, default 0.06). A ramp with no pattern is grown matter: blobs a few cells wide.
  growth?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>   // What grows out of a face that wears `tones`, as stacks of small cubes: up to six rules; the first rule that grows on a cell owns it: `on` ("top", "side", "under"), `clump` (the drifts' size in cells, a power of two 2 to 64, default 16), `cover` (the share of such faces inside a drift, 0 to 1), `density` (the share of a drift's cells that grow a stack, 0 to 1), `height` (`[least, most]` in cubes, 1 to 16), `width` (cubes across, 1 to 4), `step` (the share of stacks whose tip steps aside: a bent blade, 0 to 1), `head` (cubes of a head one cell wider than its stalk: a flower, 0 to 4), `shade` (-1 to 1, away from or toward deep corner shade), `ramp` (`[root, tip]`: two shares 0 to 1 of the face's ramp where the stack's root and tip sit, default 0.2 and 0.9), `tones` (up to four colours of the stack's own) and `headTones` (up to two of the head's; a colour past the count is dropped). A picture alone: no collider, no cell.
  material?: ScriptedMaterialSpec   // An object's scripted material on this block's faces; uv() is metres across a face, normalWorld and positionWorld the face's, vertexColor() its color; plain while it is broken.
}
